title: Soft scrambled eggs
description: A five-minute breakfast kids can help make.
steps: Whisk the eggs, milk and a pinch of salt in a bowl.
Melt the butter in a pan over low heat.
Add the eggs and stir slowly with a spatula until just set.
Take off the heat while still a little glossy, season and serve.

title: Overnight oats
steps: Stir the oats, milk, yogurt and honey together in a jar.
Cover and refrigerate overnight.
Top with berries in the morning.

title: Grilled cheese and tomato soup
steps: Heat the soup and milk in a saucepan, stirring now and then.
Butter one side of each slice of bread.
Make sandwiches with the cheese inside and the butter outside.
Cook in a pan over medium heat, 3 minutes a side, until golden.
Cut in half and serve with the soup.

title: Sheet-pan chicken tacos
ingredients: Salsa, cheese and lettuce to serve
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F (220°C).
Slice the chicken, peppers and onion into strips.
Toss with the oil and seasoning on a sheet pan.
Roast for 20 minutes, stirring once.
Warm the tortillas and set out the toppings.

title: Spaghetti with meat sauce
description: A weeknight favorite that freezes well.
steps: Chop the onion and garlic.
Brown the beef with the onion in a large pan, then add the garlic for a minute.
Pour in the sauce and simmer for 15 minutes.
Meanwhile cook the spaghetti in salted water and drain.
Toss the pasta with the sauce and top with Parmesan.

title: Veggie fried rice
description: Uses up leftover rice and vegetables.
steps: Heat the oil in a large pan or wok over high heat.
Stir-fry the vegetables for 3 minutes.
Push them aside, scramble the eggs in the space, then mix in.
Add the rice and soy sauce and stir-fry until hot.
Top with sliced green onions.

title: Lemon baked salmon with potatoes
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C).
Halve the potatoes, toss with oil and salt and roast for 15 minutes.
Add the salmon to the pan, season and top with lemon slices.
Roast 10–12 minutes more, until the salmon flakes.

title: Banana muffins
description: A good use for very ripe bananas.
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F (175°C) and line a muffin tin.
Mash the bananas, then stir in the butter, sugar and egg.
Mix in the baking soda, salt and flour until just combined.
Fill the cups two-thirds full and bake for 18–20 minutes.
